name: Should I choose a tank or tankless water heater?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a tank or tankless water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between a tank and tankless water heater depends on your household's hot water demands, space availability, and budget. Tank water heaters are generally more affordable upfront and easier to install, providing a large reserve of hot water. Tankless units offer on-demand hot water, saving energy by only heating water when needed, and take up less space. However, they have a higher initial cost and may require system upgrades. We can help you evaluate which option best suits your specific needs.
